case: Hinterkaifeck farm murders, Gemeinde Wangen, B.A. Schrobenhausen, Bavaria
crime_date: disputed: 1922-03-31 evening [S2] vs 1922-04-01 evening [S82]; courts use 'night of 31 March to 1 April' [S96]
victims: Viktoria Gabriel, 35, widowed owner of the farm [S48]
Maria Baumgartner, 45, maid, first day of service 1922-03-31 [S79]

claims.claim: Six residents found dead 1922-04-04 afternoon; Munich Polizeidirektion alerted by telephone 18:15 same day
Death by skull-crushing blunt instrument; Kreuzpickel sent for blood testing 1922-04-06 showed no blood traces (Merkel, 1922-04-10)
Reuthaue found 1923 at the demolished site with human blood, human/hare/cat hairs, no fingerprints; handle sworn-identified as Gruber's own work (Sigl, 1923-07-05)
2,207 M gold/silver coin found at scene, only 5 M paper money; drawers rummaged; Anneser denies the 3,000 M gold and scattered-banknotes versions
Securities at bank Friedl & Dummler intact; all sales pre-crime; 1,824.70 M paid in cash to Viktoria Gabriel 1922-03-02
House key reported missing days before the murders; tracks from forest to farm, none returning; Gruber declined help
claims.status: attributed (single-witness chain via Jakob Siegl, 31-year retrospection)

claims.claim: Cattle fed at the murder farm over several days after the crime
Schlittenbauer entered the house alone with the previously missing key and passed the bodies in a narrow passage without noticing them
claims.status: attributed (1953 summary; diverges from Sigl's own 1922 protocol per 1929 review)

claims.claim: Postman found Friday's mail still in place on Saturday; house usually kept locked
Incest convictions of Andreas Gruber (1 year Zuchthaus) and Viktoria (1 month) by LG Neuburg 1915-05-28; prison registers document service
Schlittenbauer acknowledged paternity of Josef (b. 1919-09-07) with a sham 1,800 M settlement before Vormundschaftsgericht, 1919-09-30
Kreszentia Mayer nee Gump named her brothers Anton and Adolf Gump as the murderers to two priests independently in 1941/42; both found her mentally normal
claims.status: attributed (deathbed hearsay, 19-20 years after the crime)

claims.claim: Anton Gump denied knowing the Hinterkaifeck area despite four years of local farm work; gave shifting accounts of a 1922 visit
Magdalena Schindler confirmed wandering with Adolf Gump through Tegernbach/Waidhofen/Schrobenhausen/Hohenwart and reported his detailed narrative of the murders
Karl Gabriel fell at Neuville 1914-12-12 and is buried at his company's trench position per regimental commander's signed report
Court file burned in the Augsburg Justizpalast fire 1944; only police duplicates survive
Prosecution time-barred: murder prescribed after 20 years absent a valid interrupting act against the true perpetrator (Bavarian Justizministerium, 1953)
1931 police evaluation: Schlittenbauer's guilt 'very unlikely'; Maier's accusations rated gossip
Pfleger warrant lifted 1935-02-01: accuser 'hysterisch', her scene description contradicts the record
Gerauer excluded (executed 1921-05-09, one year before the crime); Heinrich Amberger excluded (in Zuchthaus Kaisheim at the material time)
Pocketknife found under the Tennenboden during 1923 demolition; no fingerprints, no blood
Munich dragnet screened hundreds of itinerants (vagrants, tinkers, traveling craftsmen) without result
